specs.title: API-0023: Related products are other products from the same category

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id and take its category id.
Send GET /products/{productId}/related with that id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is an array with at most 10 items.
Verify no item has the requested product's id.
Verify every item's category id equals the product's category id.
Verify every item's category has id and name.

specs.title: API-0020: Get product returns the product with its category, brand, image and specs

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id and name.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id equals that id and its name equals that name.
Verify the body has description, price, is_location_offer, is_rental, co2_rating, in_stock, is_eco_friendly, product_image, and a brand with id and name.
Verify the category has id, name, slug and parent_id.
Verify specs is an array and every spec has id, product_id, spec_name, spec_value and spec_unit.
Verify in_stock is a boolean.

specs.title: API-0022: Get product with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send GET /products/{productId} with a well-formed ULID that no product has.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0021: Get product with an admin token returns the stock count

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify in_stock is a number.

specs.title: API-0001: Search by name returns only matching products

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with q=pliers.
Verify the response status is 200 and the body is paginated (data, total, current_page).
Verify total is greater than 0 and every item's name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).
Verify each item has an id, a name and a price greater than 0.
Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with a new unique product name.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /products/{productId} with that id returns the new name.

specs.title: API-0044: Update product with a name longer than 120 characters returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with a 121-character name that starts with a unique product name.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a name key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0045: Update product with a description longer than 1250 characters returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with a 1251-character description.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a description key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0046: Update product with a name that isn't a string returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with name set to a number.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a name key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0047: Update product with a description that isn't a string returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with description set to a number.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a description key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0048: Update product with a non-boolean is_location_offer returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with is_location_offer set to the string "not-a-boolean".
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has an is_location_offer key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0049: Update product with a non-boolean is_rental returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PUT /products/{productId} with that id and a body with is_rental set to the string "not-a-boolean".
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has an is_rental key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0050: Update product with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send PUT /products/{productId} with a well-formed ULID that no product has and a body with a unique product name.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

Verify email equals the default user's email, and id, first_name and last_name are not empty.
